punchline: A radio soap opera moved what Rwandans thought was normal.
thirty_sec: In post-genocide Rwanda, Elizabeth Levy Paluck ran a yearlong experiment at 14 sites with about 40 adults each, comparing a reconciliation soap opera with a health one. The drama shifted perceived norms and behavior (dissent, intermarriage, trust) while personal beliefs barely moved; how long it lasted is unknown.
question: Which behavior around you continues mainly because each person assumes the others expect it?
key_contrast: Private opinions barely moved; perceived norms moved.
